title: Real-Time MIDI Call-and-Response Generation Using Autoregressive Transformers
description: Code and reproducibility outputs for adapting an offline autoregressive Transformer to real-time MIDI call-and-response. Version 1.1.0 includes a harmonized 27,000-row structural evaluation, exact score specification, A0-A6 activation audit, direct Call100 endpoint benchmark, 150 ms scheduler replay, aggregate blind-listening evidence, and the revised manuscript.
notes: This archive excludes model weights, license-sensitive source datasets, generated MIDI response batches, participant-level response exports, exclusion identifiers, private blind-study answer keys, deployment credentials, piano sample libraries, VST plugins, and DAWs.
